name: lunos-community

mcp.name: git

mcp.name: fetch

mcp.name: playwright
mcp.description: Browser automation driven by accessibility snapshots rather than screenshots. Maintained by Microsoft under Playwright's own licence.

mcp.name: github
mcp.description: Repository management and GitHub API access, maintained by GitHub. Runs as a container, so it needs Docker.

mcp.name: postgres
mcp.description: PostgreSQL schema browsing and SQL execution, with a restricted read-only mode.
